data.name: Maker's Jump
data.description: Whenever the synthesist is fused with his eidolon, the synthesist can cast dimension door as a spell-like ability using his caster level. This ability only affects the fused synthesist and eidolon. The synthesist can use this ability %1/day.|MakersJumpTimes
